description: This file defines models, interfaces, and classes related to tooltip rendering for time series charts in the Thingsboard UI, including formatting functions, tooltip settings, and rendering logic.

classes.name: TimeSeriesChartTooltip
classes.description: Class responsible for creating and rendering tooltips for time series charts, including formatting and DOM manipulation.

methods.name: formatted
methods.description: Generates the tooltip HTMLElement based on chart data and settings.

methods.name: buildItemsTooltip
methods.description: Builds individual tooltip items and optionally adds total for stacked series.

methods.name: shouldShowItem
methods.description: Determines if a tooltip item should be displayed based on zero-value hiding setting.

methods.name: createElement
methods.description: Creates a DOM element with optional styles.

methods.name: applyFont
methods.description: Applies font styles and color to an HTMLElement.

methods.name: constructTooltipDateElement
methods.description: Creates a date display element for the tooltip.

methods.name: constructTooltipSeriesElement
methods.description: Creates a series data display element for the tooltip.

methods.name: constructTooltipTotalStackedElement
methods.description: Creates a total value display element for stacked series.

methods.name: mapTooltipParams
methods.description: Maps raw chart data parameters into structured tooltip items.

methods.name: appendTooltipItem
methods.description: Adds a tooltip item to the tooltip parameters list.
